name: Kasih Seorang Ayah
source:
You will play as the young husband of a family who will have your first child.
Since this is your first child, you certainly feel pleased and happy but mixed with fear and worry as well. At that time, you just started your own business, thus you worry that you can't keep your wife's condition so she can give birth safe ans sound.
Can you keep your wife healthy and your business steady for 9 months?
translation:
你将扮演一名即将迎来第一个孩子的年轻丈夫。

这是第一个孩子，你当然感到高兴、幸福，同时也混杂着恐惧与担忧。此时，你刚开始经营自己的事业，担心无法照顾好妻子，让她平安生产。

你能让妻子保持健康，让生意稳定九个月吗？
